 ICC CWC League 2 2026: Oman vs Netherlands – Match 144 predictions, cricket preview and team analysis, November 2
 Netherlands team celebrate ©REUTERS 
 By Cricket World Staff 
 Sunday 1 November 2026 
 ICC CWC League 2 
 ODI series Schedule 144th ODI, Dubai Live Oman Netherlands Netherlands elected to bowl
 Live scores and commentary 
 Oman take on the Netherlands in Match 144 of the ICC CWC League 2 2026 on November 2, with both teams looking to secure valuable points in the ICC Cricket World Cup qualification competition.
 Here are the Predictions for the ICC CWC League 2 2026, Match 144 - Oman vs Netherlands, to be played on the 2nd of November at the ICC Academy, Dubai.
 Batting Stats ODI 
 Match 144 - Oman vs Netherlands (ICC Academy, Dubai) 
Ground Stat:
Average First Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 244
Average Second Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 216
 Current Form Netherlands:  
 Netherlands are currently placed at the 3rd position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 19 wins, 12 losses and 4 No Result Matches to their credit. 
The top run scorer for Netherlands in the ICC CWC League 2 is Max O'Dowd with 1276 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for Netherlands in the ICC CWC League 2 is Aryan Dutt with 49 scalps under his belt. 
 Netherlands have lost their previous match against UAE by 5 wickets. 
Netherlands batted first and they posted a total of 263 for 4 in 50 overs. Cedric de Lange got out for a golden duck. After his dismissal, Noah Croes also threw it away and Netherlands looked in troubled waters. Max O'Dowd once again showcased his class and smashed 106 runs in 119 balls, hitting 10 fours and 3 sixes. Scott Edwards also contributed healthily with a knock of 94 runs as Netherlands managed to get to a competitive total of 263 in 50 overs of play.
During the chase, UAE lost 3 early wickets and couldn't get off to an ideal start. However, youngsters Adeeb Usmani and Akshdeep Nath had their back. Usmani made 81 off 93 balls while Nath scored 99 runs off only 88 balls, collecting 5 fours and 4 sixes. On the back of such brilliant knocks from both of them, UAE got home in the 49th over with 5 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Oman:
 Oman are currently placed at the 5th position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 15 wins, 16 losses and 3 No Result Matches to their credit. 
The top run scorer for Oman in the ICC CWC League 2 is Jatinder Singh with 1080 runs to his name. 
The top wicket taker for Oman in the ICC CWC League 2 is Shakeel Ahmed with 56 scalps under his belt. 
 Oman have lost their previous match against UAE by 4 wickets. 
Oman batted first and they posted a total of 196 before being bowled out. Jeet Shah, Hammad Mirza and Mujibur Imran Ali all got out without troubling the scorers much. Jatinder Singh tried to play an anchor's role but he kept losing partners in regular succession and the team kept losing momentum gradually. Jatinder Singh made 88 runs before being dismissed by Awais Ali Shah. Shah bowled beautifully. He picked up 5 wickets for 33 runs and wrapped up Oman's lower order. Oman were eventually bowled out for just 196.
During the chase, UAE lost the key wicket of Tanish Suri quite early. After his dismissal, Aryansh Sharma and Muhammad Shahdad batted really well. Sharma made 49 off 61 balls while Shahdad scored 21 runs to lay the foundation for a successful chase. There were a few hiccups in the form of wickets but Muhammad Waseem had their back in the middle order. He scored 43 runs off just 35 deliveries as UAE managed to get over the line in the 48th over with 4 wickets in hand.

 Oman Squad : Vinayak Shukla (C), Jatinder Singh, Hammad Mirza, Aryan Bisht, Mujibur Ali, Shakeel Ahmad, Jay Odedra, Samay Shrivastava, Hassnain Ali Shah, Zikriya Islam, Shah Faisal, Hassnain Wahab, Muhammed Imran, Saishiv Narayan, Jeet Shah
